summary: Honeywell International filed an 8-K solely to recast historical segment information following a business realignment effective Q1 2026. The filing reports no transaction, no price, no premium, no board recommendation, and no structural changes to operations or capital structure. The realignment merges certain businesses into a new Process Automation and Technology segment and adjusts Industrial Automation composition, with no impact on consolidated financials. This is a routine segment reporting update, not a special situation.
